name: com.unity.sdk.linux-arm64
description: This package contains the sysroot used to build and run Unity players on Arm64 Linux systems. It includes the system libraries and headers required by Unity’s runtime environment to ensure compatibility with common Linux distributions during both compilation and execution.

name: com.unity.sdk.linux-x86_64
description: This package contains the sysroot used to build and run Unity players on 64-bit Linux systems. It includes the system libraries and headers required by Unity’s runtime environment to ensure compatibility with common Linux distributions during both compilation and execution.

name: com.unity.toolchain.win-x86_64-linux
description: This package provides a cross-compilation toolchain for building Unity players targeting Linux and Embedded Linux platforms. It is designed to run on 64-bit(x86_64) Windows hosts and supports both x86_64 and Arm64 player targets

name: com.unity.sysroot.base
description: This is the base sysroot package required by all sysroot and toolchain packages
